objective: Profile-native ordering/finality recovery's closed Rust population is release-accountable through a fail-empty wrapper.
falsifiable_claim: npm run check:ordering-finality-recovery pins system_ordering_recovery (5) by exact name, then runs the agentgres regression suite and the ioi-consensus regression suite in the configuration CI exercises, each with a non-empty floor.
adversarial_or_fault_proof: npm run mutate:ordering-finality-recovery plants (a) an absent test name, refused by the source binding; (b) a name whose fn exists but whose module path the harness cannot list, refused at --list; (c) an empty population, refused outright — the wrapper proves it can fail on its own finding before it is trusted green.
remaining_nonclaims: The wrapper proves the pinned tests execute and pass; it does not widen what those tests assert. The unit's acceptance clauses are proven only to the extent the pinned tests prove them.
A CI floor is not yet pinned for these root-workspace wrappers; verifier-floors.v1.json covers hypervisor-app journey verifiers only.
